notes:
First dev build of Tally for Windows: the NSIS installer, with the in-app updater (it checks apps/tally/latest.json here and installs signed updates).

Backend: none. Tally keeps its books in an encrypted local file; bank sync talks to Plaid directly from the app.

Recent changes:

- chore(release): tally 0.1.1 (d30dc98)

- feat(store): version the books' schema and SurrealDB, and keep pending trades (ab1d39e)
- feat(core): trades from statements, transfer matching and recurring entries (54ed4ec)
- feat(about): open catalog links in the browser; research on selling (20ae2d8)
- feat: g3-brand About and in-app updates (65ac052)
